title: Check one skill: type, relevance, specificity and membership
summary: Jev classifies the individual term and checks why it belongs in this JD-specific Skills section and proposed group.
body: Use four ordered questions for each term: (1) What is it? (2) Why is it useful for this JD? (3) Does its displayed phrase communicate something meaningful? (4) Does it belong in the proposed group? The later assembly clarification assigns individual classification to Jev. Follow the JD and selection records for the actual requirement and selected workflow; canonical inventory is not an exhaustive tool whitelist. Apply the settled retrofit rule without reopening employer-specific technology verification. Return item judgments for group review; do not replace individual checks with one overall section judgment. Shared decision evidence and unresolved-result handling belong to module-checks. This source does not specify exhaustive classification choices or a new per-skill retry budget.
